title: Aloo Bhunna
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 & ½ tbs
steps.romanUrdu: -Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 & ½ tbs

steps.instruction: -Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -Peel & cut potatoes into pieces & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Aloo ko peel ker ka pieces mein cut ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a wok,add cooking oil,cumin seeds,curry leaves & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein cooking oil,zeera aur curry patta dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: -Add onion paste,mix well & cook on medium flame for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Pyaz paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur darmiyani ancch per 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: -Add pureed tomatoes,ginger garlic paste,salt,cumin powder,red chilli powder,turmeric powder, coriander powder,garam masala powder,mix well & cook until oil separates (12-15 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: -Pureed tamatar,adrak lehsan paste,namka,zeera,lal mirch powder,haldi powder,dhania powder aur garam masala powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur oil alag ho janay tak paka lein (12-15 minutes).
-Aloo dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add water & mix well,cover & cook on low flame until potatoes are tender (10-12 minutes) then cook on high flame until oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: -Pani dal ker mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per aloo gul janay tak paka lein (10-12 minutes) phir tez ancch per oil alag ho ajay tak paka lein.
-Hari mirch aur hara dhania dal ker mix ker lein.
-Hara dhania aur hari mirch sa garnish ker ka serve karein!

ogDescription: Lets keep it simple today. Quick easy and very tasty Aloo Bhunna recipe for you. #happycookingtoyou #foodfusion #pakistanicooking
